prompt: A wide picture for a 2D game, piece ui-purchase. A dark game menu screen in the same etched look as a clockwork title screen: charcoal and muted sepia ground, gold line work, etched clock faces and gears as ornament, hand-lettered engraved headings. Fill the whole canvas, no border. The Ella and Spells purchase screen: level and points at the top, rows with a minus and a plus button each, buttons Confirm, Cancel and Done. Style: a dark painterly etched storybook illustration, ink and wash with fine etched cross-hatching and a faint paper grain inside the shapes only. Large shapes have a clean near-black ink outline #171614 about 2 px wide at this size. One light source sits in front and slightly above: upper edges brighter, lower edges shaded with fine hatching. Palette: charcoal and ash-blue darks, muted sepia, bone ivory #FFF5DC, warm gold #E9C46A, bronze #94611E, with only tiny accents of crimson #FF3658.
